assertion_1_weights_frozen.details: ViT-B frozen: True, DINOv2 frozen: True

assertion_2_manual_forward_verified.description: Manual forward reproduces official forward (diff < 1e-5, 100% agreement)

assertion_3_preprocessing_verified.description: Correct model-specific preprocessing used independently for ViT-B and DINOv2
assertion_3_preprocessing_verified.details: ViT-B uses timm AugReg bicubic/crop0.9/mean0.5/std0.5; DINOv2 uses official 256/224/bicubic/ImageNet norm

assertion_4_split_counts_exact.description: Exact existing split identities reused with N=1000 each

assertion_5_zero_overlap.description: Zero image overlap between calibration and evaluation sets

assertion_6_no_evaluation_leakage.description: Calibration statistics computed exclusively from calibration activations
assertion_6_no_evaluation_leakage.details: Calibration statistics cache built strictly on calibration dataset before evaluation

assertion_7_cls_token_untouched.description: CLS token untouched in all primary patch interventions
assertion_7_cls_token_untouched.details: PatchInterventionHook explicitly isolates token index 0 (CLS) and only modifies spatial patches 1..N

assertion_8_patch_counts_exact.description: Spatial patch token counts exact (ViT-B=196, DINOv2=256)

assertion_9_masks_exact_and_nested.description: Fraction masks exact and nested (ViT-B: 49/98/147/196, DINOv2: 64/128/192/256)
assertion_9_masks_exact_and_nested.details: ViT-B nested: True, counts: True; DINOv2 nested: True, counts: True

assertion_11_coordinate_permutations_bij.description: Coordinate permutations are true bijections preserving L2 norm
assertion_11_coordinate_permutations_bij.details: ViT-B perms valid: True, DINOv2 perms valid: True

assertion_12_shared_noise_identical.description: Shared-noise patch vectors are identical across spatial patches within each image
assertion_12_shared_noise_identical.details: Sampled once per image as (B, 1, D) and broadcast via .expand(B, n_masked, D)

assertion_13_independent_noise_independe.description: Independent-noise patch vectors are independently sampled across spatial patches
assertion_13_independent_noise_independe.details: Sampled as (B, n_masked, D) using torch.randn

assertion_14_noise_energy_matched.description: Shared and independent noise distributions have identical marginal expected energy
assertion_14_noise_energy_matched.details: Both draw from N(0, diag(sigma_8^2)), identical marginal expected L2 norm squared E_full

assertion_15_dinov2_head_frozen.description: DINOv2 official linear classification head remains frozen and unchanged

assertion_16_dinov2_readout_reproduced.description: DINOv2 readout reproduces official [norm(CLS), mean(norm(patches))] -> head

assertion_17_seeds_match_protocol.details: All seeds hardcoded to pre-registered protocol values

assertion_18_no_labels_or_gradients.description: No labels or gradients used when constructing replacement vectors or statistics
assertion_18_no_labels_or_gradients.details: Interventions are constructed strictly from unsupervised calibration activations (mean, variance, PCA)
